# Together Music Bot

> Together Music Bot is a high-fidelity Discord music streamer and web dashboard engineered for crystal-clear 24-bit opus sound, interactive 3D WebGL webplayer visuals, 24/7 voice channel persistence, and zero-stutter playback.

Together delivers studio-quality music across Discord servers with 14 digital sound processing filters, multi-platform streaming from Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, Apple Music, and Deezer, and global listening leaderboards.

## Core Services

- [Web Dashboard](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/): Centralized web interface for server configuration, real-time player controls, and listening stats.
- [Documentation & FAQ](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/faq): Full guide covering all 59+ bot commands, 14 DSP audio presets, server configuration, and voting rewards.
- [Commands Directory](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/commands): Searchable directory of 69 prefix commands and 67 Discord slash interactions.
- [Bot Comparison & Alternatives](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/compare): Objective 2026 technical benchmark comparing Together vs Hydra, Rythm, Smooth Bot, and Jockie Music.
- [Music Leaderboard](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/leaderboard): Server and global community rankings tracked by listening time and streaks.
- [3D Webplayer Visualizer](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/commands#visualizer): Interactive browser-based WebGL audio frequency visualizer with 50+ spectrum modes.
- [Discord Bot Invite](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=863496211667484676&permissions=8&integration_type=0&scope=bot+applications.commands): Direct authorization link to invite Together to your Discord server.
- [Top.gg Voting Perks](https://top.gg/bot/863496211667484676/vote): Daily vote rewards including double streak XP, priority queueing, and exclusive audio profiles.
- [Community Support Discord](https://discord.gg/mUdGTs2Dw5): Official support guild for bot troubleshooting, feature updates, and assistance.
- [About Us & Systems Architecture](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/about): System architecture, 24-bit audio engine specs, and creator credentials.
- [Contact Technical Support](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/contact): Direct contact desk, response SLA guarantees, and support channels.
- [Official Documentation](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/faq): Complete guides, technical architecture, and release documentation.
- [Terms of Service](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/terms): Usage policies, terms of service agreements, and bot guidelines.
- [Privacy Policy](https://dash.together.dpdns.org/privacy): Privacy policy, data safety standards, and GDPR compliance disclosures.

## Bot Architecture & Commands Summary

Together Music Bot supports 59+ commands grouped into 10 documentation categories:
- Playback: /play, /pause, /resume, /skip, /forceskip, /skipto, /previous, /replay, /stop, /seek, /forward, /rewind, /speed, /sleep, /lyrics, /search, /similar
- Queue: /queue, /clear, /shuffle, /remove, /loop (track/queue/off), /autoplay
- 14 DSP Audio Filters: /filter (bassboost, 8d, nightcore, vaporwave, pop, soft, treblebass, karaoke, vibrato, tremolo, subboost, superbass, reset)
- Server Management: /247 (stay in voice 24/7), /setprefix, /djrole, /source, /ignore
- Community & Stats: /profile, /lb, /stats, /ping, /grab, /forcefix, /vote
